cases.question: 年满六十五岁的患者基数是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE age >= 65

cases.question: 请按唯一患者口径汇总老年组（65岁及以上）规模
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE age >= 65

cases.question: 以数据内最后化验日为锚点，糖尿病人群近三个月 HbA1c 均值是多少？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lab_id) AS lab_count, ROUND(AVG(CAST(COALESCE(l.value,l.item_value) AS REAL)),4) AS avg_value FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE lower(p.disease_tags) LIKE "%diabetes%" AND lower(l.item_name)="hba1c" AND date(l.test_date) >= date((SELECT MAX(date(test_date)) FROM lab_result),"-3 months")

cases.question: 最近一个季度糖尿病队列有多少 HbA1c 化验，平均结果如何？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lab_id) AS lab_count, ROUND(AVG(CAST(COALESCE(l.value,l.item_value) AS REAL)),4) AS avg_value FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE lower(p.disease_tags) LIKE "%diabetes%" AND lower(l.item_name)="hba1c" AND date(l.test_date) >= date((SELECT MAX(date(test_date)) FROM lab_result),"-3 months")

cases.question: 最新风险为高且确诊肥胖的交集队列多大？
cases.gold_sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT patient_id,risk_level,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY datetime(created_at) DESC,visit_id DESC) rn FROM patient_risk_score) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile p JOIN latest r ON p.patient_id=r.patient_id AND r.rn=1 WHERE lower(r.risk_level)="high" AND lower(p.disease_tags) LIKE "%obesity%"

cases.question: 肥胖患者中，当前最新风险层级为 high 的人数
cases.gold_sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT patient_id,risk_level,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY datetime(created_at) DESC,visit_id DESC) rn FROM patient_risk_score) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile p JOIN latest r ON p.patient_id=r.patient_id AND r.rn=1 WHERE lower(r.risk_level)="high" AND lower(p.disease_tags) LIKE "%obesity%"
